core_principles: Precision over Decoration: Every pixel has a purpose.
Terminal Aesthetic, Modern UX: Monospace for data, Sans for readability.
Community First: Content is the hero.

usage_rules: Metadata (Dates, Authors, Tags): JetBrains Mono, weight 500, text-xs or text-sm, tracking-wide.
Navigation: JetBrains Mono or Inter (depending on desired density), uppercase for labels.

colors.dark_mode_strategy: Default is Dark. Use 'class' strategy in Tailwind. Ensure dark: classes are primary.

variants.terminal: font-mono border border-[#1793D1] text-[#1793D1] hover:bg-[#1793D1]/10 bg-transparent

inputs.style: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid. Use opacity for subtlety (border-white/10 in dark mode).
visual_enhancers.shadows: None or very subtle (shadow-sm) in dark mode. Sharp shadows in light mode.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 border-b border-border/40 sticky top-0 z-50
visual_enhancers.terminal_decor: Use '>_' or '$' prefixes in purely decorative elements (not actual content) to evoke terminal feel.

motion.hover_effects: translate-y-[-2px] for cards, scale-[1.02] for distinct items.

images.style: Abstract, Geometric, Blue-toned, Architectural. No stock people photos.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is at least 4.5:1 against background. Check #1793D1 against white (might need darker shade for text).
accessibility.aria: Use accessible names for icon-only buttons.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients on the primary blue. Keep it flat.
DO NOT use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Stick to rounded-sm, rounded-md, or rounded-lg (max).
Use JetBrains Mono for 'meta' information (Usernames, Dates, Tags).
Use Inter for long-form reading (Articles, Tutorials).
Dark Mode is the default. Design for Dark Mode first.
Respect the 'Arch' aesthetic: Minimal, Functional, Fast.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React application using JS (not TS). Ensure all components are .js or .jsx. Use the provided colors in tailwind.config.js. Implement the 'Arch' aesthetic by using the specific font pairings (Inter/Mono) and strict border/color usage defined above.
